advice: Flag tools returning user-generated or outside content with untrustedContentHint so agents treat it as data, not instructions.
detail: WebMCP convention (Chrome/Moz docs). Applies to MCP too: trades reviews, provider messages, and any quoted third-party text need the flag once hosts enforce it; adopt the field now so the gate is ready.

advice: Every error must name the next valid action (wrong state, bad params, empty results, rule violations) — never raw dumps or silence.
detail: Chrome's build-tools patterns map 1:1 onto our FailureCodes; needs_user_decision with allowedActions is the compliant shape. Implemented as recoveryError() in apps/web; audit each new failure for its recovery sentence.

advice: Version-stamp every platform rule with introduced/last_verified/source/host/spec_version/confidence — never encode docs as timeless truth.
detail: xmcp: older Apps SDK syntax already aged out; current MCP Apps _meta.ui format replaced legacy _meta.openai (widgetAccessible, invoking/invoked strings have no MCP equivalent). Our intel items carry last_checked/status for exactly this; re-verify quarterly.

advice: Build capabilities against standard MCP Apps with the ChatGPT surface as an overlay — never fork tool identity per host.
detail: Skybridge: always-on standard transport + optional proprietary overlay detected at load, per-method routing, dual metadata emit, content-hash cache busters. ext-apps ships migrate-oai-app skill — near-official convergence acknowledgment. Our capability → transport → view split already matches; adopt their migration checklist (CSP-origin audit, CORS set, grep sweep) when we add UI.

advice: Learn platform boundaries with tiny single-purpose probe apps, not the flagship — then promote findings to gate checks.
detail: Gavin Ching speedran ~10 micro-apps and found: no write tool calls on mobile, PIP disappearing on non-widget follow-ups, all widgets/resources loaded at connection time, wss:// CSP coercion bug. Each boundary becomes one probe app + one gate check + one intel entry.

advice: Write a distinct, behavior-true justification per tool hint — copy-pasted hint text across tools draws rejection questions.
detail: Community question (unresolved): is repeating one generic openWorld justification acceptable? Assume no. Our 9 tools each need their own reason recorded — the submission skill's tool-hint justifications section exists for exactly this.

advice: Describe user intent, not implementation — models select tools on description semantics, and review checks it.
detail: Official define-tools guide + announcement discovery mechanics agree: 'Find vetted local tradespeople…' beats 'Comprehensive lead-generation platform'. Audit all 9 tool descriptions against this before submitting.

advice: Ship 3–9 boring, reliable tools per app — never mirror internal APIs and never expose supplier operations.
detail: Matches plan.md's core rule and OpenAI's tightly-scoped guidance. Our server exposes 9 intent verbs, zero supplier-named ops (transport test asserts this).
